sentences.text:
Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Milind Ramesh Phadke
 On The 11 th Of June, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 21083 of 2024
 Between:-
 Buddhasen @ Babu @ Ugrasen Kevat S/O Shri
 Chhedilal Kewat, Aged About 26 Years,
 Occupation: Labour, Resident Of Village
 Patehara Kadariya, Police Station Atraila
 District Rewa (Madhya Pradesh)
 
 (By Shri K.D. Singh - Advocate)
 And
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh Through Police
 S Tat I O N Atraila District Rewa (Madhya
 Pradesh)
 
 (By Shri Narendra Lodhi - Panel Lawyer)

This application coming on for admission this day, the
 following:
 Order
Case diary is perused.
Learned counsel for the rival parties are heard.

The applicant has filed this first application u/S 439,
Cr.P.C for grant of bail.

The applicant has been arrested by Police Station Atraila, District Rewa (M.P.) in connection with Crime No.222/2023 registered in relation to the offences punishable u/Ss.
363, 366, 376(2)(n) of IPC and 5/6 of POSCO Act, 2012.

The case of the prosecution is that the complainant, father of prosecutrix 2 MCRC-21083-2024 on 30.11.2023 submitted a written application to the police station In-charge of Police Station Atraila to the effect that his daughter/the prosecutrix aged 16 years had gone somewhere at night of aforesaid date without informing anyone and on search she could not be found.

On the basis of aforesaid Buddhasen @ Babu @ Ugrasen Kevat vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120903704/
1 complaint, missing report was registered and investigation was initiated.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: After investigation, the applicant was prima facie found to commit the offence, thereupon, Crime No.222/2023 for the aforesaid offences were registered against him.
Counsel for the applicant submitted that in her statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C, the prosecutrix has not supported the case of prosecution.
On these grounds he prayed for grant of bail.
P e r contra, the application is opposed by the State Counsel.
It is submitted that at the time of incident the proseucutrix was aged about 16 years, therefore her consent is immaterial.

After hearing the learned Counsel for the parties and going through statements of prosecutrix recorded u/s. 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 1,00,000/- (Rs. One Lakh only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court.

This Order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following conditions by the applicant :-
1.
The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigation Officer, as the case may be.
A copy of this order be sent to the Court concerned for compliance.
C.c as per rules.

(MILIND RAMESH PHADKE) V. JUDGE rv Buddhasen @ Babu @ Ugrasen Kevat vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120903704/
